verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms is a developer-facing payments platform with SDKs, a dashboard and an official MCP server, so asking whether telemetry or usage tracking can be turned off is a fair privacy question. None of the evidence mentions telemetry, analytics collection or any opt-out setting. The fraud-monitoring and device-binding items cover other features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
